_note: Pull-rate heuristics by rarity tier. No public API exposes real pull rates, so we approximate `packsPerRarityHit` (packs you open per hit of ANY card in that rarity slot) from community-reported averages for modern Scarlet & Violet-era English sets. Override per-set when you have better numbers. `chaseCardsInTier` is derived at runtime by counting cards of the same rarity in the set.
